import json, subprocess, sys, time, tempfile, pathlib
req = json.load(open('/workspace/tests/near_cap.json'))
# add 256 queries of 4096 tokens? cap is 16384 total tokens -> use 4 queries of 4096
req['queries'] = [[req['services'][i % 2] for i in range(4096)] for _ in range(4)]
lines = [json.dumps(req).encode()]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    t0 = time.time()
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', str(pathlib.Path('/workspace/submission/main.py').resolve())],
                         cwd=cwd, input=b''.join(l + b'\n' for l in lines), capture_output=True)
    dt = time.time() - t0
print('elapsed %.2fs rc=%d' % (dt, run.returncode), run.stderr.decode()[:300])
obj = json.loads(run.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0])
print('ok', obj['ok'], 'states', len(obj['dfa']['next']), 'query results', len(obj['queries']), obj['queries'][0])
EOF
